copy.curiosityHook: Can these gentle prehistoric giants navigate modern New York and reach the Museum of Natural History before Professor Screweyes derails their mission?
copy.description: Fed a special cereal by time-traveler Captain New Eyes, intelligent prehistoric dinosaurs visit New York City to grant children's wishes, soon crossing paths with the Captain's evil brother, Professor Screweyes.
copy.vibeSummary: Lighthearted, briskly paced animated adventure with low viewing demand and plenty of colorful family charm.
copy.whyWatch: At a breezy 71 minutes, this animated family adventure delivers an inventive science-fiction premise full of playful city detours and exciting classic villainy.

allowedMaterial: Captain New Eyes traveling back in time and feeding dinosaurs Brain Grain cereal
Journey to New York City to grant children's wishes
Planned meeting with Dr. Bleeb at the Museum of Natural History
Detours with new children friends and encountering Professor Screweyes
excludedMaterial: Resolution of the conflict with Professor Screweyes
Late-stage plot turns or circus developments beyond the initial encounter
Third-act resolutions and ending fates of the dinosaurs and children
